name: worktree-subagent-pipeline
description: Sequential worktree-subagent pipeline for pl-829f: each step's agent works in an isolated git worktree cut by the harness. GOTCHA: the provisioner cuts worktrees from a stale commit (old main tip), NOT the current k8s-migration tip — every agent must 'git reset --hard k8s-migration' (or --ff-only merge) before starting, and verify a sentinel file from the previous step exists. Merges back are then clean fast-forwards. Also: agents' bash cwd can drift to the shared checkout — enforce absolute paths rooted at the worktree.

Pre-commit hook GIT_DIR/GIT_INDEX_FILE leak corrupts the real repo from tests: a real-git test (clone-apply) run under the hook inherited GIT_DIR and committed into the main repo, truncating .mulch/.seeds and flipping core.bare=true (repaired with git config core.bare false). Test-level beforeEach env-clearing proved insufficient — three later commits still hit it under the hook and needed --no-verify.
resolution: Repaired repo with git config core.bare false; durable fix tracked in warren-fa84: scrub GIT_* vars at the Bun.spawn env in clone-apply.ts itself rather than relying on test-level env clearing.

name: k3d-live-validation-gotchas
description: Live k3d validation gotchas for WARREN_RUNTIME=k8s: (1) default k3d image ships containerd 1.4 which does NOT report OOMKilled on cgroup v2 — use rancher/k3s:v1.31.5-k3s1+; (2) Bun fetch cannot present client-cert (mTLS) kubeconfig credentials (k3d/kind default) → 401; run warren in-cluster with ServiceAccount bearer token + NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt; (3) set WARREN_K8S_IMAGE_PULL_POLICY=Never for node-local imported images or :latest defaults to Always and ImagePullBackOffs; (4) keyless validation works: claude-code's 'Not logged in' result(is_error) drives the full dispatch→events→terminal→reap chain without an Anthropic key.

Two pod-log streaming defects found in first K8s E2E: (a) openAndConsume batched parsed events and only yielded them when the follow connection ENDED — a live follow stays open for the pod's life, so events (incl. the terminal result) never reached the bridge and runs wedged in queued; stream consumers must yield per-chunk. (b) kubernetes client-node Log.log pipes response.body with no error listener on the source; node-fetch emits AbortError on the source at abort → uncaughtException crashing the control plane on every teardown. Also: PodLogOptions sinceSeconds:0 is an HTTP 422, not a no-op.
resolution: Rewrote openAndConsume as a per-chunk-yielding async generator (ca07c78c); attached a source error listener via the sink's pipe event swallowing only AbortError (ea9b5a98, warren-595f); removed sinceSeconds:0.
